==Notes==
*Dark Bond only transfers damage to minions under the caster's control, not other allied minions.
*This skill can be easily maintained without assigning attribute points to Blood Magic.

== Trivia ==
[[File:Dark Bond alpha icon.jpg|thumb|Alpha icon]]
*The minion shown in the [[skill icon]] is a [[bone fiend]].
*During early alpha, both the icon and skill effect were different. The description used to read: {{quote|Whenever target enemy takes damage, you lose the same amount of health. Whenever you take damage, target enemy loses the same amount of health.}} The energy cost was 15 and the skill was considered a "Necromancer Life Spending Skill."
